# Floating Paradise

> Handcrafted, solar-powered eco resort with overwater bungalows in Karimunjawa Island, Central Java, Indonesia.

## Key Facts
- Location: Legon Lele, Karimunjawa, Central Java, Indonesia
- Coordinates: -5.8024, 110.4473
- Rooms: 3 private overwater bungalows (Sunrise, Sunset, Bayside)
- Power: 100% solar-powered, off-grid
- Rating: 4.8/5 (96 reviews)
- Price range: $$
- Check-in: 12:00 | Check-out: 10:00
- Contact: +62 822 2694 5510
- Email: floatingparadise.legonlele@gmail.com
- Website: https://floatingparadise.id

## Pages
- [Home](https://floatingparadise.id/en): Overview, hero, bungalow listings
- [Bungalows](https://floatingparadise.id/en/bungalows): 3 room types with descriptions and pricing

- [Yoga Retreat](https://floatingparadise.id/en/yoga-retreat): "The Art of Floating" 7-day retreat program
- [Getting Here](https://floatingparadise.id/en/getting-here): Transport from Semarang/Jakarta to Karimunjawa

- [Contact](https://floatingparadise.id/en/contact): WhatsApp, email, address
- [FAQ](https://floatingparadise.id/en/faq): Accommodation, food, booking, transport, activities

## Unique Features
- Only floating eco guesthouse in Karimunjawa
- Direct reef access for snorkeling from bungalow
- Natural ventilation (no AC needed)
- Sustainable tourism focused
- Handcrafted wooden construction
